findings.title: Silence menu action cannot open a drawer for Prometheus-only Grafana rules
findings.body: The new list supplies only `promRule`, so `AlertRuleMenu` can expose “Silence notifications” based on `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` and clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true. However, the drawer is rendered only when a Ruler alerting rule is present (`rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`), which is false when `rule` is undefined. Consequently the menu item is visible and clickable but produces no UI or action in the alert list.

findings.title: Delete is unavailable for Grafana rules rendered without a Ruler payload
findings.body: Although `canDelete` now includes the Grafana Prometheus-rule ability, the delete menu item still additionally requires `rulerRule`. `GrafanaRuleListItem` only passes a `promRule`, so users with delete permission never see Delete in the new Grafana alert list. The delete handler passed by `RuleActionsButtons` only needs the already computed identifier, so retaining this payload guard removes an existing rule-management operation.

findings.title: Pause action is hidden for Prometheus-only Grafana list entries
findings.body: `canPause` now correctly considers the Grafana Prometheus-rule ability, but rendering the pause item still requires a Grafana Ruler rule. Since the new list intentionally no longer loads or passes that Ruler rule, the pause/unpause operation disappears from the list even for editable Grafana-managed alerting rules. The pause action needs to be migrated to operate from the Prometheus representation/identifier or omitted from the advertised supported abilities.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: The previous implementation determined federation from `rule.group` via `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. This replacement unconditionally sets `isFederated` to false, including when called through `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`, which still receives the complete `CombinedRule`. Federated datasource rules can therefore be presented as editable, deletable, pausable, or restorable when the prior behavior intentionally disabled those operations, risking invalid or unintended changes to federated rule groups.

findings.title: Grafana rule view links no longer preserve the current list location
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleListItem` built its view URL with `createReturnTo()`, allowing the rule view to navigate back to the current filtered/paginated alert list. The replacement creates a bare view URL, so opening a Grafana rule from the list loses the filter/search return target and returns users to the default alerting location instead of their current result set.
